final: SELECT r.raceId, c.country, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS entry_count, COUNT(*) - AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS above_average FROM constructorResults AS cr JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country HAVING COUNT(*) > AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () ORDER BY above_average DESC LIMIT 10
